title: Marketplace
intro: Signed plugins from the official Marketplace, and from sources the server's operator added. Installed plugins start switched off; turn them on under Installed. Floorbit checks every download's signature, and the local agents get the official ones on their own.
empty: The Marketplace lists no plugins yet.
removeQuestion: Remove {{name}}? Its settings stay, for when you install it again.
installed: {{name}} {{v}} is installed. Turn it on under Installed.
builtin: This one ships with this Floorbit: nothing to install.
withdrawn: Version {{v}} was withdrawn: {{why}}. Update or go back to another version.
unlisted: No source lists this plugin any more. It keeps running; you can remove it.

area.context_menu: right-click entries on the floor plan
area.agent: runs a part on the local agent
area.panels: boxes in the side panels of seats, switches and devices
area.layers: a layer on the floor plan
area.pages: pages of its own in the sidebar
